effect.shortEffect: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.
effect.full: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.

english.ch: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
